## D — Graduated licensing and license records
Each knowledge sentence carries one physical-page anchor and one fact identifier. The author completed a separate source-fidelity pass before submission; independent coverage and hallucination QA remain pending.
Scope exclusions and source issues: Page seventeen contributes GDL content only. Fee tables and license-duration schedules conflict with other chapter text and are withheld as debt. Appointment instructions conflict between pages eleven and twenty; no blanket scheduling rule is asserted.
Dynamic disposition: Current fee amounts and inconsistent license-expiration schedules are withheld; appointment-policy conflicts remain debt.
Text-only extraction cannot establish the meaning of an unreadable diagram. Any such material is withheld until a page-specific visual observation is recorded.

corpus_stability.reason: This is a bounded snapshot of the issuer-linked Montana handbook. Its revision conflict is explicitly held as debt; there is no evidence in the supplied source of multiple substantive rewrites per year. Currency of individual changeable provisions is not inferred from this assessment.

verification_debt.claim_text: Age-based license terms on page eighteen conflict with standard-license duration on page thirteen and the quick reference on page eleven. No term schedule is asserted.
Fees and administrative charges on pages eighteen through twenty require current issuer evidence; no monetary values are asserted.
Page twenty says every station requires appointments, while page eleven states participating-station exceptions. Resolve official current appointment policy.
